offers_products.reason: Main offerings are TV series and films on AMC, AMC+, Acorn TV, Shudder and BBC America (content products).

offers_services.reason: Technical Services unit provides network origination and distribution for MSG and other clients. It is a smaller part of the business.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Viewers subscribe directly to AMC+, Acorn TV, Shudder and similar streaming services.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Cable and satellite distributors pay carriage fees and advertisers buy airtime. Technical services clients include MSG Network.

recurring_revenue.reason: Streaming subscriptions, cable and satellite carriage fees, and ongoing advertising generate repeat revenue.

cyclical_demand.reason: Subscriptions and affiliate carriage fees persist in recessions, though advertising, a smaller part, is cyclical; consumers keep cheap streaming.

big_ticket.reason: Subscriptions to AMC+ and Acorn TV, and carriage fees and ads, are small and frequent.

people_delivered.reason: Customers pay for content and streaming platforms and channel delivery, not mainly for staff time.

large_customers.reason: Streaming subscribers are households. Distributors and advertisers are also buyers, but households make up much of the revenue.

asset_heavy.reason: Content producer and programmer with streaming brands; one Bethpage technical facility, but mainly content library investment, not heavy plants or networks.

notes: AMC Networks' mix of subscriber, distributor and advertising revenue is not stated on the site. Answers rely on prior knowledge of the company.
